mission: Inspect every discoverable DreamCo bot, division, capability, tool, API/integration and critical repository dependency; classify connection truth and automatically route every non-working state to an accountable builder path.
working_definition: Repository evidence shows the entity exists, has its required canonical references, and applicable generated/runtime/test evidence is present. External services additionally require authorized runtime evidence before they can be called working.

classification_rules.working: required source/reference/evidence exists and no known blocker is present
classification_rules.disconnected: entity exists but no canonical routing/consumer/registry path can be found
classification_rules.partial: some required connection stages exist but one or more verification stages are missing
classification_rules.duplicate: multiple competing canonical identities or exact stable IDs are discovered
classification_rules.missing_dependency: a required referenced file, executable, package, builder output, adapter or prerequisite is absent
classification_rules.needs_builder_bot: a measured non-working state has no existing safe repair implementation and needs an assigned builder lane
classification_rules.external_adapter_unverified: the API/integration is declared but no current authorized runtime verification exists
classification_rules.generated_at_runtime: the consumer path is valid but the evidence artifact is intentionally produced by a builder/run

release_blockers: required Run Everything tool path missing
required builder output has no builder
quality_checks: bot belongs to exactly one canonical division unless explicitly shared
external connection truth is separated from internal file connection
every non-working entity has a builder assignment
truth_rule: Internal repository connectivity never proves an external API/platform is authenticated or live. The auditor must prefer partial/unverified over a false working claim and must keep every gap visible until evidence closes it.
